DATED CLAIM & SOURCE LEDGER

Six measures, with their counting rules

Section link

These institutional counts refer to records as at 17 July 2026. NPSY & Co. signed the two reports on 3 September 2026. The SRS 4400 report records factual findings under agreed procedures; it gives no assurance conclusion. The separate SAE 3000 report gives limited assurance on specified assertions or floors. Neither establishes clinical outcomes.

Download the structured ledger (JSON) · Download the six measures (CSV) · Read the full claim-to-page map

Cumulative services
31,052,382 defined services
SRS 4400 factual finding: p3 item1. SAE 3000 limited-assurance scope: ≥31,000,000 defined services; p4 A1; p6 therapy-service definition.
Therapy service includes 1:1 therapy, structured assessments, screenings and parent training. It does not mean 31 million independently verified successful therapy sessions.
Counting rule: Includes 1:1 therapy, structured assessments, screenings and parent training; it is not a count of successful therapy sessions.
Exact source-page map · Factual-finding record · Limited-assurance record
Beneficiary / family registrations
792,614 beneficiary/family registrations
SRS 4400 factual finding: p3 item2. SAE 3000 limited-assurance scope: ≥790,000 beneficiary/family registrations; p4 A2; p6 beneficiary/family-registration definition.
Unique beneficiary or family registration counted once under the criteria. Not a separate count of 792,614 unique children, households with home therapy, or proven clinical outcomes.
Counting rule: One registration under the stated criteria; it is not a separate unique-child or outcome count.
Exact source-page map · Factual-finding record · Limited-assurance record
Operational centres
49 centres meeting report criteria
SRS 4400 factual finding: p3 item3. SAE 3000 limited-assurance scope: ≥40 centres meeting report criteria; p4 A3; p6 operational-centre definition.
Operational means a location with lease/ownership rights, location registration/listing, staffing roster and platform activity in the preceding 90 days. The report names Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Delhi.
Counting rule: Requires premises rights, location registration/listing, staffing roster and recent platform activity; seven centres were physically visited.
Exact source-page map · Factual-finding record · Limited-assurance record
Network-trained practitioners
2,293 network-trained/certified practitioners
SRS 4400 factual finding: p3 item4. SAE 3000 limited-assurance scope: See the specified floors in the SAE 3000 source page; p4 A4; p6 certified-practitioner definition.
Certification means completion of the network's defined training/certification pathway. It does not establish current employment, RCI registration, or independent professional licensure for every practitioner.
Counting rule: The defined network training/certification pathway does not establish current employment or RCI licensure for every person.
Exact source-page map · Factual-finding record · Limited-assurance record
Structured developmental records
At least 2,700,000,000 structured platform records/events
SRS 4400 factual finding: p3 item5. SAE 3000 limited-assurance scope: ≥2,500,000,000 structured platform records/events; p4 A5 assures >=2,500,000,000 floor; p6 data-point definition; p7 IT reliance.
Structured records/events: session logs, assessment observations, technique ratings, sensor events or equivalent mapped fields. Not unique people, independent trial observations, or established deduplicated AI-training examples; no general IT-controls audit.
Counting rule: Events and mapped fields, not unique people, independent trial observations or deduplicated AI-training examples.
Exact source-page map · Factual-finding record · Limited-assurance record
Patent applications
16 distinct patent applications
SRS 4400 factual finding: p3 item11 continued p4. SAE 3000 limited-assurance scope: ≥13 PCT applications only; p4 D1; p7 application-count definition.
Applications filed, not patents granted; no conclusion on novelty, enforceability, global exclusivity or every invention described.
Counting rule: Thirteen PCT and three Indian applications, without duplicate phases; these are filings, not granted patents.
Exact source-page map · Factual-finding record · Limited-assurance record

Use the relevant original source and counting definition when quoting a measure. This company-prepared export is a navigation aid; it does not replace either signed report or its circulation conditions.
